text: No, it wasn’t about you. It was about that Bundesliga striker in the video everyone’s been sharing this week. If you think every joke is about you, that’s your problem, not mine.

Oh, okay, sorry. I guess I just felt a bit sensitive because of Sunday. I know I messed up and it’s been on my mind. I didn’t mean to accuse you or anything, really. If it was just about that video, then I totally misunderstood.
Yeah, well, you did. I wasn’t thinking about your miss at all. I just told the story because it was funny. If you want to talk about Sunday, fine, but don’t drag me into your guilt trip.

Alright, I get it. No need to get defensive. I just wanted to clear it up because it sounded a bit pointed, that’s all. I don’t expect you to care, but it’s not like I’m searching for sympathy either. Forget it.
Fine, whatever. I wasn’t trying to make you feel worse, but if you want to take it personally, that’s up to you. I’ve got nothing else to say about it.
Understood. I won’t bring it up again. Enjoy your evening.
